question: In which practices are bliss and related states used?
premises: Bliss and related states are instrumental.
Japa, stotra, meditation, homa, worship, and so on are the practices.
inference: Bliss and related states accompany japa, stotra, meditation, homa, worship, and similar practices.
uncertainties: The full list after ādiṣu is not given.
plain_english: With bliss and so on, in japa, stotra, meditation, homa, worship, and so on.
